notes.title: Collaborators and Volunteers Wanted
notes.content:
Dear Omega Pattern users,

First of all, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to our Kickstarter’s backers, the [url=https://twitter.com/patron_omega/status/968606682740703232]websites and portals[/url] that covered the campaign and the Omega Pattern First Part’s customers for their support and confidence in Omega Pattern. Unfortunately, we haven’t gotten enough funds for the Omega Pattern Final Part nor DLC continuation.

However, we keep wanting to finish Omega Pattern because we really feel that we are making something different and our story deserves to be told. Therefore, we are going to try another crowdsourcing method and look for [b]collaborators and volunteers[/b] who want to help us to develop and finish the Omega Pattern Final Part.

Please, have in account that not being funded and using a working methodology based on collaborations and volunteer work will slow us down and it won’t allow us to set a release date at this moment, so we recommend you to follow us on Twitter and Facebook as well as check the Omega Pattern blog and website if you want to be up to date about the Omega Pattern Final Part’s latest news, development progress and future release dates.

We are also planning to make the Final Part more affordable, lighter and shorter. But don’t worry, we are not planning to sacrifice the main experience and quality!

Finally, if you think that you could help or you might know anyone who could be interested in helping us with the following tasks:

[list][*]Translation: From Spanish to English and from Spanish (or English) to any other language.
[*]Art: Any resources (Backgrounds, Character Sprites and CGs) drawing, keeping the Omega Pattern First Part art style.
[*]Voice acting.[/list]

Please, contact us through our [url=https://www.facebook.com/omegapattern]Facebook Page[/url], [url=https://www.twitter.com/patron_omega]Twitter[/url] or website’s [url=http://www.patronomega.com/en/#contact]contact form[/url] or just leave us a message!

Thank you very much for your support and collaboration!

David Ridao, Omega Pattern developer.

notes.title: We need your help on Thunderclap! + KICKSTARTER SALE
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Our Kickstarter will start next Wednesday 21 February and we would like to ask you to devote one minute of your time to support it on our Thunderclap page before the deadline. You just have to:

1. VISIT: https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/67820-omega-pattern-kickstarter

2. Click on Support with Facebook, Twitter and/or Tumblr.

And that's it! You and the rest of supporters will share the message on February 22.

But that's not all; the First Part of Omega Pattern is available FOR ONLY 3,49$ THIS WEEKEND!

Don't forget to follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/omegapattern]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.twitter.com/patron_omega]Twitter[/url] and help us spread the word!

THANKS A LOT!
